episodes.synopsis: Tired of the Sunday Showdown charade, Fighter D decides to defeat the Rangers for real this time.
episodes.title: We Are Justice! The Dragon Keepers!

episodes.synopsis: Fighter D reunites with Yumeko Suzukiri, who approaches him with an unexpected proposal.
episodes.title: Go! Fighter D!

episodes.synopsis: Fighter D decides to infiltrate the Red Garrison with Yumeko, only to find himself in a tight spot.
episodes.title: Our Evil Will Bloom, Someday.

episodes.synopsis: In pursuit of Fighter D, Aran Hekiru, a Blue Junior Third Rank, discovers his connection to Hibiki.
episodes.title: The Soldier with Love, Hibiki!

episodes.synopsis: Fighter D infiltrates the White Dragon's Nest in disguise and discovers someone in hiding.
episodes.title: Fighter D, as a Part of “Ranger Force”

episodes.synopsis: Fighter D and Kai Shion work together to face off against Shun Tokita in the final exam.
episodes.title: 1 Plus 2 Equals... Threat!

episodes.synopsis: Fighter D's plans go awry as Shion works with the other cadets on the second day of the exam.
episodes.title: The Zigzag Road to the Final Exam!

episodes.synopsis: Peltrola sneaks into the White Dragon's Nest, and meets Komachi Aizome of the Blue Squadron.
episodes.title: Shout Out Loud, Cadets!

episodes.synopsis: Fighter XX steps in to help Fighter D but is stopped by Blue Keeper with his Divine Artifact.
episodes.title: Battle! Fever! Fighter D!

episodes.synopsis: Peltrola retreats after an all-out fight with Blue Keeper, but is halted by the Junior First Ranks.
episodes.title: It's Showtime for Blue Keeper!

episodes.synopsis: The cadets, Junior First Ranks, and Blue Keeper team up against Peltrola and their clones.
episodes.title: On the Road to My Justice!

episodes.synopsis: Fighter D engages in a head-to-head fight with Blue Keeper despite his overwhelming disadvantage.
episodes.title: Never Stop, Fighter D!
